scalars.scalar_value: Experience with process optimization and Lean Six Sigma with demonstrated ability to apply business requirement concepts into the development of tools and applications.
Days, 8 hrs/day, Mon - Fri, 8:00 am - 4:30 pm - Hybrid

items.item_text: Job offer is contingent upon satisfactory clearance based on Background Check results.

Mandated Reporter: This position has been identified as a Mandated Reporter pursuant to the California Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act and requires immediate reporting of physical abuse, sexual abuse, emotional abuse, or neglect of anyone under the age of 18. It is the responsibility of the Mandated Reporter to ensure that they obtain proper training in order to fulfill their reporting responsibilities as required by the California Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act and University policy, and to complete and submit the required reports to the UC San Diego Police Department without delay.
Experience with process optimization and Lean Six Sigma with demonstrated ability to apply business requirement concepts into the development of tools and applications.
Experience with financial analysis, and management and analysis of operational drivers. Ability to independently gather required information to organize and perform process analysis assignments.

Highly skilled in all levels of project management. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage full project lifecycles, and develop structured reporting frameworks for communicating project status and impact to diverse stakeholder audiences.
Expert knowledge of the organization's processes, protocols and procedures and external regulatory requirements in policy domain. Ability to multi-task with demanding timeframes.

Ability to focus on priorities, strategies, and vision. Ability to assess organizational need, refocus quickly from one activity or role to another, manage multiple projects and change priorities quickly as circumstances dictate.

Ability to coach, facilitate, and influence people. Ability to work collaboratively with a range of professional associates across multiple departments, including cross-functional teams with members from both business and technical units. Proven interpersonal skills with peers throughout the organization; strong service orientation and critical thinking skills; and attention to detail.
Expert knowledge of applicable policy analysis techniques.
Expert knowledge of common organizational- or research-specific and other computer application programs.
Highly skilled communication and interpersonal skills to communicate with and influence others, both verbally and in writing.
Ability to use discretion and maintain all confidentiality.
Expert analytical / problem-solving skills. Ability to think independently to design and develop solutions and procedures.

Demonstrates ability to learn quickly, reason, synthesize and generalize based on information obtained. Strong analytical and research skills with attention to detail and the ability to summarize findings into concise and relevant documents and presentations.
